body:
2 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

The stories:

Sunderland held to a draw at Rochdale in League One clash (Rochdale). Sunderland took the lead twice but were unable to secure a win against Rochdale, resulting in a frustrating draw in their League One fixture.

Hopwood Hall College celebrates topping out of new Clegg Building (Hopwood). A topping out ceremony at Hopwood Hall College marks a significant step in the construction of the new Clegg Building, set to enhance educational facilities in Rochdale.

Weather: Cloudy 12°C in Rochdale today.
